reviews.comment: Professor Schwartz is one of the best professors I have ever had. He is extremely knowledgeable, and he can break down class material in a way that is easy to understand. Also, I appreciate that he is practical and doesn't assign busy work. I know he is retiring this year, but this is probably my favorite business class that I have ever taken.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really really liked him. Only tests so you will need to study the lecture slides but I thought they were very doable.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best prof at A&M!!! No seriously, the most caring, respected, and wise professor. Although he is retiring this semester, he will forever leave a mark at Texas A&M!

Really good guy, very funny, very engaging even during the more boring lectures. he said it himself "if i didnt want to be here i wouldnt" which shows that he is passionate about teaching. 4 exams were decently challenging, but not ridiculous. highly highly recommend him.

Very knowledgeable!! I didn't think that I would like this class, but I do find myself really interested in Law now. His lecture style isn't for everyone, the slides have all of the words already there (you're not having to write much down additionally), but he will give brief examples and answer questions in class. Four exams only- not cumulative!

This professor is the worst professor I have taken at Mays. I read all of these reviews and thought he would be amazing, he is not. His material isn't extremely complicated, but the his exams are a nightmare. He treated it like an advanced law class, meanwhile it's a CBK. Also, if you go to ask him clarification he is extremely rude and unpleasant.

Schwartz is a great prof!! His lectures are memorable from his clear and animated examples, and the exams follow the materials in ppt and lecture. You are only graded on 4 exams, and he provides some ec where he sees fit (usually for those who attend class). The concepts are not too difficult, but are fast-paced and have many details to remember.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Best MGMT 311 professor you can take. If you go to class, you will do well on tests. His explanations make the content much easier to understand. Tests are difficult but he provides plenty of extra credit opportunities throughout the semester IF you go to class. You have to study the material if you want to do well in this class.

Good proff. He did scare me a little because he was very serious in person, but he is funny once you get to talking a bit more. This class grade is based off 4 exams. That. is. all. My advice is to score as high as you can on the first exam bc that is the easiest, and then just be very consistent with the other three.

My personal favorite professor and the best law professor ever. If you need to take MGMT311, choose Schwartz. Lectures are amazing and he talks a lot about his personal experiences as a lawyer. The total grade is 4 tests and attendance isn't required, but I would STRONGLY recommend going and giving him a listen. He makes me want to study law now!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
311*

Mark Schwartz is the best professor I've had at Texas A&M. He makes class interesting because he is extremely funny and gives constant real examples and stories. He has extra credit on every test, and it is very clear what is expected of us. He is not one of those professors that makes tests 10 times harder than lectures. He is the best!

311. I was nervous before beginning this course because the only grades were exams. However, an A very is attainable if you go to class and listen to his examples. He makes his own exams so there are a lot of questions from the lecture and keeps lectures entertaining with hypotheticals and his real life experience as a lawyer. Recommend!

311* I took Schwartz for 311 but no course option for that. He is quite possibly my favorite professor ever. He makes classes engaging and understands the material he's teaching is difficult so he tries to simplify it. There are only 4 exams but they're very doable if you just go to class and review your notes/slide decks.

Professor Schwartz is a great guy and he made a class with only lectures interesting. Going to class isn't mandatory, but he delivers the lectures with in depth examples that you won't get from just reading the slides online. Now the class is only exams for grades, so don't slip. Anyways, Schwartz is a super nice and someone you'll love.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Schwartz is such a great professor! Final grade was only based off of 4 exams, all noncumulative, but they were extremely doable if you study the lecture slides and go to class. He usually gives examples in class that are really helpful to study for exams. Overall, he is super nice and tries to make the material as engaging as possible.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mark is great and if you did well in 311 you'll do well in this class! The 8 am killed me but even if you missed a few classes, as long as you study the PowerPoints and pay attention to his examples you'll get an A. There's only 4 exams but he tries to give extra credit when he can. Overall a good class!
reviews.ratingTags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Schwartz is an amazing professor. He works hard to go over all materials on the exam, and he is always accessible outside of class. Such a funny guy who loves what he does. MUST TAKE!

Took as an online, synchronous course. Grade was based on four exams. None cumulative. Schwartz gives good examples and sets you up to succeed, if you put the effort in. About half of the content is review of 211, but was SO much easier to understand. I learned so much from this guy, even with my attention disappearing about 45 min in.

Schwartz is one of the best profs I've ever had. He teaches from experience (as a former lawyer), he wants everyone to understand the material, and he gives lots of examples. His tests are NOT hard if you study your notes and pay attention to his examples. His sense of humor is on point as well. I cannot recommend Schwartz enough. TAKE HIS CLASS!!!

This was my favorite class this semester and I'm not in the business school! He warned early on that this will not be an easy class, but if you pay attention to the lectures (which is quite easy to do, he makes them interesting and entertaining) then this class will be quite easy. His exams mostly consists of his in-class lecture examples.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Really good prof, actually cares if you learn or not. It's a lot of material and can be hard, but there's a lot of opportunities for extra credit. Love Schwartz

After taking Swim for 211, this guy was amazing. He is clear about what is and what isn't on the tests and actually try's to help you understand the content in lecture. Attendance isn't mandatory and the book gives really helpful examples. He also gives extremely easy extra credit questions fro the book. 4 tests, each 25% of your grade.
